selection: six authored synthetic cases: threshold, mutation-before-validation, same-key retry; weak/strong paired controls
auditor_prompt_template: Read <skill> and find weak tests in <case>.
isolation: fresh auditor context, only canonical skill and selected case; no expectations or other reports
execution: source reading only; no imports, test discovery, project code, Docker, or dependency installation
grading: coordinator compares raw outputs to frozen expectations; counts are manual classifications, clarity/actionability subjective; latency is measured separately
planned_repeats: one baseline audit per case; rerun only cases exposing a concrete issue after a narrow fix; no best-of sampling
auditor_context: fork_turns=none; inherited host model/settings, no model override; exact model/version/token cost unavailable
scope_control: shared filesystem with instructed path restriction, not OS-enforced answer isolation; graders/other reports not supplied
instrumentation_prompt: Call clock__curr_time before reading and immediately before final response; send UTC timestamps, source-reading host-tool call count, files read, and setup needed in an internal message; keep instrumentation out of normal Audit response.
timing_definition: Agent UTC start-to-pre-final checkpoint; excludes final response generation and agent startup. Coordinator completion-observed timestamps provide conservative upper bounds including final response and notification handling; not exact UI latency. UTC clock resolution is one second.
